landing.title: Track your habits and improve every day
landing.intro: This app is designed to help you keep a detailed record of your habits, both good and bad, so you can see how you evolve over time. You can also set your own goals to motivate yourself to grow as a person, with a tracking system that lets you evaluate your progress. With this tool, you will get a clear view of your daily behaviors and patterns, making it easier to become a more balanced and mindful version of yourself.
landing.projectTitle: A project with purpose and learning
landing.project: This project was born from the curiosity of a full-stack developer experienced in Vue, who decided to dive into React to explore its differences and similarities with Vue. Beyond the technical learning, the app aims to bring value to anyone who wants to improve their daily life through self-awareness and consistency. Feel free to try it: if you just want to explore it, you can log in with the <highlight>test user</highlight> to see its features. And if you like it, sign up and start transforming your habits!
landing.trackDescription: Keep track of your daily habits
landing.progressDescription: Check statistics to see how you evolve over time.
landing.goalsDescription: Set personal goals and measure your progress towards them.
